display.purpose: Home heading and large empty states; one per screen at most.

headline.purpose: Workspace and environment titles in the page header; selected environment on Home.

title.purpose: Dialog titles, empty-state titles, the Home lead Play label.

body.purpose: Base size: rows, sidebar items, environment names, dialog messages.

body-sm.purpose: Secondary copy, meta lines, buttons, fields, tabs, callouts, toasts, section titles.

label.purpose: Table headers, tags, small buttons, status bar. Sentence case, no tracking.

micro.purpose: Count pills and dense diagnostic paths only.

mono.purpose: Data only: paths, versions, log lines, config keys, hashes, IDs.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Selects, dropdowns, context menus, popovers, downloads panel.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on every focusable control.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Halo on focused fields, with the border turned accent.

shadows.name: row-focus
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on list and table rows.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Hover/selection colour changes on buttons, rows, tabs, nav.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion collapses all animation and transition durations.

breakpoints.name: home-compact
breakpoints.purpose: Home rows drop the status column.

breakpoints.name: dialog-short
breakpoints.purpose: Dialogs pin to the top edge.

breakpoints.name: launch-wrap
breakpoints.purpose: Launch feedback strip wraps its actions.

themeContract.source: src/utils/theme.ts applies built-in theme variables, then custom theme variables, inline on <html>; src/styles/foundation.css derives every --simm-* token from them.

narrative.overview:
SIMM is a tool people open right before they play, and again when something breaks. The redesign keeps the incumbent modern-blue identity on purpose (maintainer decision: recognition over reinvention): dark navy-graphite surfaces, one blue accent, the app icon, the sidebar-plus-workspace shell. What changed is execution. Every surface is built from one token system and one primitive vocabulary, density is that of a desktop utility rather than a web dashboard, and each screen leads with the next safe action while developer depth sits one tab away.

The world is flat and tonal. Regions separate by a step in surface tone and a 1px line, never by shadow; shadows exist only on things that float above the page (dialogs, popovers, toasts). Colour is spent sparingly: the accent marks the primary action, the current selection and focus, and the four status hues carry meaning only. Data carries the UI: lists, tables, key/value facts and inspectors come before cards.

Confirmed visual rejections (PRODUCT.md brand commitments): no landing-page heroes, bento grids, feature-card grids, glows, decorative gradients, or emoji in UI copy.
keyCharacteristics: Dark navy-graphite tonal stack: background, chrome, panel, sunken, each one step apart.
One blue accent, deepened for fills so white labels pass 4.5:1 on every theme.
Fixed rem type scale (11 to 22px) in Geist, monospace only for data.
4px spacing grid; 32px controls, 40px rows, 28px status bar.
Flat at rest; shadows only on overlays.
One status per object (dot + word), compact outlined tags for runtime and source.
Derived from the theme API, so built-in and custom themes restyle the whole app.

rules.name: The Three Jobs Rule
rules.body: The accent marks the primary action, the current selection, and focus. Nothing else: no accent headings, accent icons in content, or accent borders on panels.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Rule
rules.body: Status hues appear only when they report a state. A green or amber element that is not a status, tag or callout is a defect.

rules.name: The Derived-Not-Declared Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never hard-code a colour. They read `--simm-*` tokens, and those derive from the theme API (`--app-bg-color`, `--primary-btn-color`, `--badge-*` ...). A literal hex in a surface stylesheet breaks light and custom themes.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Type sizes come from the seven `--simm-text-*` steps in rem on a 16px root. No `vw`, no `clamp()`, no root-font scaling at 1440p or 4K; the layout must look the same at 1080p, 1440p and 4K.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace only for things a user might copy or compare character by character: paths, version numbers, log lines, config keys and raw config, hashes, IDs. Never for labels, headings or decoration. Tables and `.ui-num` use tabular numerals instead of mono.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No uppercase tracked kickers above titles. A section is named by a sentence-case `section title` (13px, 600, text-secondary) that is the name of the block, not a category label.

rules.name: The Overlays-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: If it does not float above the page, it has no shadow. Panels, rows, cards, buttons and the Home list are flat.

dos: **Do** build new surfaces from the foundation primitives (page, page header, toolbar, line tabs, panel, section title, table/row, split + inspector, kv, status, tag, meta line, callout, empty state, danger zone) before writing a new class; extend with a modifier.
**Do** use exactly one primary (`accent-fill`) button per surface: the action the surface exists for. Everything else is secondary, outline or ghost.
**Do** keep destructive actions quiet (outlined danger-text) and apart in a danger zone; reserve solid red for the confirm button of the dialog that performs the destruction.
**Do** give every object one status (dot + word) and put runtime/source in outlined tags on a meta line.
**Do** read colours only from `--simm-*` tokens and keep them derived from the theme API so light, dark, modern-blue and custom themes all work.
**Do** use the fixed rem type steps (11, 12, 13, 14, 16, 18, 22px) and the 4px spacing grid.
**Do** separate regions with tone and a 1px line; give shadows only to dialogs, popovers and toasts.
**Do** verify a visual change with the screenshot harness at both 1600x1000 and 1280x800 before calling it done.
donts: **Don't** add eyebrows or uppercase tracked kickers above titles; name a block with a sentence-case section title.
**Don't** build stat tiles, KPI rows or dashboard number cards; counts belong in a status, a tab count, or the status bar.
**Don't** nest panels or put cards inside cards; a panel is one bounded region with one job.
**Don't** use coloured side stripes (thick left borders) to mark tone or selection; tone goes on the whole callout, selection is the blue wash.
**Don't** size type with `vw`, `clamp()` or root-font scaling at desktop breakpoints.
**Don't** use monospace for labels, headings or decoration; mono is for paths, versions, logs, config and IDs.
**Don't** use landing-page heroes, bento or feature-card grids, glows, decorative gradients, or emoji in UI copy.
**Don't** use status hues decoratively or the accent for anything but the primary action, selection and focus.
**Don't** hard-code hex values in surface stylesheets.
